title: Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Countertop Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Brass Paper Towel Holders | Allied Brass
short_title: Paper Towel Holder 14-Inch Countertop, Fire Engine Red
description:
Stop chasing a loose roll and clear the clutter from your kitchen counter with a dedicated paper towel holder that stays put and looks finished in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional kitchens hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Count on enduring strength with solid brass construction
- Finish your space cleanly with concealed screw mounting hardware for straightforward installation
- Match your kitchen hardware with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Countertop paper towel holder (paper towel valet)
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 5 in. x 14 in. x 5 in.
- Mounting: Concealed screw mounting hardware
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembly: Assembled in the USA
